changes.zh: 冰見表及書甚懼，以其絕遠，非所能制，遂與何充等奏聽皝稱燕王。
changes.before: Yu Bing, terrified yet unable to coerce him from afar, joined He Chong in recommending that the court recognize the title of king of Yan.
changes.after: On seeing the memorial and the letter, Yu Bing was greatly alarmed; because Huang was so far away and beyond his power to control, he joined He Chong and others in memorializing that Huang be allowed to style himself King of Yan.
changes.reason: English omits 見表及書 (seeing the memorial and letter) and 等 (and others).

changes.zh: 於是率騎二萬出蠮螉塞，長驅至於薊城，進渡武遂津，入于高陽，所過焚燒積聚，掠徙幽、冀三萬餘戶。
changes.before: He led twenty thousand horse through Wengong Pass, raced to Ji, crossed Wusui Ford into Gaoyang, burned depots, and carried off thirty thousand households from You and Ji.
changes.after: He then led twenty thousand cavalry out through Yiweng Pass, drove straight to Ji city, advanced across Wusui Ford into Gaoyang, burning the stores wherever he passed, and carried off more than thirty thousand households from You and Ji.
changes.reason: 蠮螉塞 is Yiweng Pass, not Wengong Pass; 餘 (more than) was omitted.
